What is the output of a = [1,2,3]; b = a; b.append(4); print(a) ?

Supplied answer
[1, 2, 3, 4]. b = a does not copy the list, it only creates a second name for the same object, so the change
is visible through both names. Use a.copy() or a[:] to make an actual copy.
